title: Goofy Ahh Running
blurb: Rubbery, frantic footsteps that make dignity structurally impossible. Cartoon sprint audio upgrades any chase into a circus act, the legs apparently moving faster than the body, and applying it to real footage does the same trick instantly. Play it over people running for buses they will not catch, over dogs doing zoomies at eleven at night, over tactical retreats from responsibilities that will still be there tomorrow. Nobody has ever looked cool while this sound was playing. The animators designed it that way on purpose.
origin: Cartoon sprint audio from the goofy ahh genre.
